title: Jammy German Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful one-pot stew featuring colatura and slow-cooked lentils, perfect for a cold winter evening. This jain-friendly dish is made in a donabe vessel.
instructions: Heat the donabe vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and celery and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the rinsed lentils, colatura, tomato paste, vegetable broth, bay leaves, and thyme.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves and season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Continue to simmer, uncovered, for an additional 10 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the stew has thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
